card.text: Explore Metis with Galileo imagery on a dimension-constrained shape.

introduction.text: Metis is Jupiter’s innermost moon, a small elongated world embedded in the main ring. Dust knocked from its surface helps replenish that faint ring. Synchronous rotation is assumed; its actual rotation period is unknown.

normal.title: SSI mosaic
normal.summary: The finest source pixels span about 3 km; other views are coarser. Brightness is adjusted; the gray grid marks unreliable data.
